title: Business Examinations
markdown:
Anglia Exams offers a range of **Business English Exams** that test the English proficiency level of students whose special interest is business. The exams are divided into four steps, ranging in level from A2+ to C1 on the CEFR, and test all four skills of reading, writing, listening and speaking. [The exams are designed to evaluate the linguistic competence of candidates who may be considering a future in an international workplace or may already be working in the professional world](https://www.anglia.org/exams/business-english-exams)[1](https://www.anglia.org/exams/business-english-exams).

If you’re interested in taking one of these exams, you can visit [Anglia Exams](https://www.anglia.org/exams/business-english-exams) for more information.

# Business English Exams

English is the lingua-franca of business. No matter where in the world you live or work, the ability to communicate effectively in English is a definite advantage when conducting business. In an increasingly globalised world, being proficient in business English gives you a competitive edge.![English for Business EFL step by step](https://www.anglia.org/images/Site-Images/Exams/BusEnglevels.jpg "Business English Exam Levels")

The four steps of the Anglia Business English exams, ranging in level from A2+ to C1 on the CEFR, test the English proficiency level of students whose special interest is business.  Candidates may be considering a future in an international workplace or may already be working in the professional world and be keen to evaluate their linguistic competence.

With an emphasis on practical business application in realistic situations, our communicative exams offer a progressive choice of levels: A2+, B1, B2 and C1, and test all four skills of reading, writing, listening and speaking.
